subject.title: fix(clickclack): deliver media and configurable model replies [AI-assisted]

question: Should ClickClack expose a permanent per-account `maxTokens` setting, or should this bug be fixed with one maintained plugin default?
rationale: The hard-coded 96-token budget is demonstrably inadequate, but adding a new public config key and quadrupling the implicit budget affect ongoing compatibility, cost, and product surface in ways source correctness alone cannot settle.

options.title: Use one plugin default
options.body: Fix the truncation by selecting a suitable maintained ClickClack model-mode default without adding another configuration key.

options.title: Sponsor `maxTokens`
options.body: Accept the per-account setting after documenting the cost/latency implications and proving both default and overridden live behavior.

recommendation.title: Use one plugin default
recommendation.body: Fix the truncation by selecting a suitable maintained ClickClack model-mode default without adding another configuration key.
